info.title: Course Catalog API
info.summary: Contract-first API for courses, instructors, prerequisites, and webhooks.
info.description:
The Course Catalog API is the shared contract for the multi-team course
catalog platform. This document is normative: `openapi.yaml` and the Zod
schemas in `src/schemas` must describe the same shapes.

## Conventions

- All routes are served under `/v1`.
- JSON is the only request and response media type.
- Single resources are returned as `{"data": <resource>}`.
- Paginated lists are returned as `{"data": [...], "page": 1, "limit": 20, "total": 0}`.
- Errors always use `{"error": {"code", "message", "details?", "requestId"}}`.
- Resource IDs are prefixed: courses use `crs_`, instructors use `ins_`,
  students use `stu_`. Webhook subscriptions use `whs_`, deliveries use
  `whd_`, events use `evt_`, and request IDs use `req_`.
- Timestamps are RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC strings (for example,
  `2026-03-01T15:00:00Z`).

## Authentication and authorization

Every operation except `GET /v1/health` requires a Bearer JWT:
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The token claims are `sub`, `role`, `iss`,
and `exp`. The supported roles are `student`, `instructor`,
`catalog_admin`, and `service`. Each operation declares its accepted roles
with the `x-required-roles` extension. See `docs/auth.md`.

## Webhooks

Publishing a course emits `course.published` version `1.0`. Subscribers
receive the event envelope described by `CoursePublishedEvent`, signed with
`X-Catalog-Signature`. See `docs/webhooks.md`.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of courses. The `q` parameter searches course
code, title, and description. All authenticated roles may call this
operation.

post.description: Creates a draft course. Only catalog administrators and services may create courses.

Location.description: Canonical URL of the created course.

get.description: Returns a single course by ID. All authenticated roles may call this operation.

patch.description:
Applies a partial update to a course. At least one field must be
present. Publishing is a separate operation. Only catalog
administrators and services may update courses.

post.description:
Publishes a draft course and emits a `course.published` version `1.0`
webhook event. A published course requires at least one instructor and
no unsatisfied catalog validation errors. Only catalog administrators
and services may publish courses.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of instructors. All authenticated roles may call this operation.
Returns a single instructor by ID. All authenticated roles may call this operation.

put.description:
Replaces the complete prerequisite set for a course. The operation is
atomic. A course cannot list itself, duplicate a course, or introduce a
prerequisite cycle. Only catalog administrators and services may update
prerequisites.

post.summary: Check direct prerequisites against completed courses
post.description:
Evaluates a stateless eligibility check from the supplied completed
course IDs. Only direct prerequisite rules marked required are
considered; optional prerequisites never block eligibility. Grades and
student records are not read. All authenticated roles may call this
operation.

Evaluates whether a student satisfies the prerequisites for a course.
Students may only check their own `studentId`; instructors, catalog
administrators, and services may check any student. This
student-record-based operation remains part of the long-term contract
but is not implemented by the current Worker. Use
`POST /v1/prerequisites/check` for stateless direct-prerequisite
checks.

Registers an HTTPS endpoint for catalog events. The response includes a
`signingSecret` exactly once; store it securely and use it to verify
`X-Catalog-Signature`. Only catalog administrators and services may
create subscriptions.

201.description: The subscription was created and the signing secret is returned once.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of webhook delivery attempts. Filter by
subscription, event, status, or event type. Only catalog administrators
and services may inspect deliveries.

200.description: A paginated collection of webhook deliveries.

get.description:
Returns service and dependency health. This operation is public and
does not require a Bearer token.

post.description:
Outgoing webhook delivery contract. The request body is the
`CoursePublishedEvent` envelope. Subscribers must verify
`X-Catalog-Signature` using the subscription signing secret, reject
timestamps outside the five-minute replay window, and deduplicate by
event `id`. Any 2xx response is treated as successful delivery.

parameters.name: X-Catalog-Signature
parameters.description: Signature header in the form `t=<unix>,v1=<hex hmac-sha256 of t.body>`.

parameters.name: X-Catalog-Event-Id
parameters.description: The event identifier. Duplicate deliveries share this value.

200.description: The subscriber accepted the event. Any 2xx response is successful.

bearerAuth.description:
Bearer JWT issued by the catalog identity provider. Required claims are
`sub`, `role`, `iss`, and `exp`. Local development uses HS256 with
`JWT_SECRET`; production should migrate to asymmetric keys via JWKS.
See `docs/auth.md`.

WebhookEventIdFilter.description: Filter deliveries by event identifier. All retries of one event share this value.

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed or contains an invalid parameter.

Unauthorized.description: The Bearer token is missing, expired, malformed, or has an untrusted issuer.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated role or subject is not allowed to perform this operation.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current resource state.

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request is syntactically valid but violates a business rule.

TooManyRequests.description: The caller exceeded the request rate limit.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The service or a required dependency is unavailable.

EventId.description: Prefixed event identifier. Retries of the same event share this ID.

RequestId.description: Prefixed request identifier used for tracing and support.

instructors.description: Full instructor records. Present on single-course responses.

prerequisites.description: Prerequisite rules. Present on single-course responses.

Instructor.description: An instructor in the catalog directory.

required.description: Whether the prerequisite is mandatory. Defaults to true.

minimumGrade.description: Minimum grade percentage required to satisfy the prerequisite.

completedCourseIds.description: Course IDs the caller has completed. Defaults to an empty list.

eligible.description: True when every required direct prerequisite is completed.

missing.description: Required direct prerequisite course IDs that are not completed.

EligibilityReason.description: Why a prerequisite check succeeded or failed.

WebhookSubscription.description: A webhook subscription. The signing secret is never included here.

WebhookSubscriptionCreated.description: A newly created subscription with its one-time signing secret.

signingSecret.description: One-time secret used to verify `X-Catalog-Signature`. It is never returned again.

attempt.description: Number of delivery attempts made so far.

EnrichmentSource.description: Whether enrichment came from Workers AI or the deterministic fallback.

CoursePublishedEvent.description:
Immutable `course.published` event envelope. Consumers must deduplicate
by `id`.

details.description: Optional structured context, such as field-level validation errors.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope used by every failure response.

HealthStatus.description: Health state of the service or a dependency.
